title: Tiny, cute motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="38" ry="4" fill="#2a1a5e" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="74" r="13" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="74" r="10" fill="#5c5c8a"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="74" r="6" fill="#8a8ab8"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="74" r="3" fill="#c8c8e8"/>

  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="74" r="13" fill="#3a3a5c"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="74" r="10" fill="#5c5c8a"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="74" r="6" fill="#8a8ab8"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="74" r="3" fill="#c8c8e8"/>

  <!-- swingarm / rear frame -->
  <rect x="30" y="66" width="22" height="6" rx="3" fill="#e8443a"/>

  <!-- engine block -->
  <rect x="38" y="54" width="20" height="16" rx="4" fill="#f2a03d"/>
  <rect x="42" y="58" width="12" height="8" rx="2" fill="#ffd166"/>

  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x="14" y="62" width="16" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#c0c0d8"/>

  <!-- main body / fuel tank -->
  <path d="M34 50 Q34 38 46 36 L64 36 Q76 38 76 50 L70 58 L40 58 Z" fill="#e8443a"/>
  <path d="M36 48 Q36 40 46 38 L64 38 Q74 40 74 48 L70 54 L40 54 Z" fill="#ff6b5e"/>

  <!-- seat -->
  <path d="M44 38 L64 38 Q66 34 62 32 L48 32 Q42 32 44 38 Z" fill="#4a4a6a"/>

  <!-- handlebar stem -->
  <rect x="68" y="42" width="5" height="14" rx="2" fill="#c0c0d8"/>

  <!-- handlebars -->
  <rect x="60" y="40" width="18" height="4" rx="2" fill="#e0e0f0"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="42" r="3" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="42" r="3" fill="#ffd166"/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="50" r="6" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="50" r="3.5" fill="#fff8c0"/>

  <!-- front fork -->
  <rect x="70" y="56" width="5" height="16" rx="2" fill="#c0c0d8"/>

  <!-- rear fender -->
  <path d="M16 64 Q16 58 24 58 L30 58 Q32 62 30 66 L18 66 Z" fill="#ff6b5e"/>

  <!-- small heart detail on tank -->
  <path d="M56 44 Q56 41 58 41 Q60 41 60 44 Q60 41 62 41 Q64 41 64 44 Q64 48 60 50 Q56 48 56 44 Z" fill="#fff8c0" transform="scale(0.6) translate(36 26)"/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx="14" cy="44" r="1.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="62" r="1.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="36" r="1" fill="#ff9df0"/>
</svg>
